Juice Wrld airport footage got recently released showing the moment he overdosed .….. 💔🕊️

Juice WRLD, whose real name was Jarad Higgins, passed away on December 8, 2019, at the age of 21 after suffering an accidental medical emergency at Midway International Airport in Chicago. Following a private flight from California, law enforcement officers searched the plane, during which Higgins experienced a severe seizure. Though medical personnel administered the opioid antagonist Narcan and transported him to Advocate Christ Medical Center in Oak Lawn, Illinois, he was pronounced dead shortly after arrival. An official autopsy report released in January 2020 by the Cook County Medical Examiner’s Office concluded that his death was an accidental overdose caused by acute oxycodone and codeine toxicity.
